answer: Inter-arrival jitter fingerprinting. Each identity’s request timing must carry a distinctive jitter signature, like a plume drifting on its own breeze, and clustering of near-identical signatures flags coordinated creation. An attacker must synthesize plausible human-like timing variance per identity, an island of effort for each fake account, since copying one jitter profile across a meadow of identities triggers detection. Diverging every profile costs custom timing models plus real-time schedule maintenance, scaling linearly with fleet size.
